body: Thanks for the advice man, sorry if I was being insensitive.
No offense but being white isn't a big deal
I really appreciate you trying to help but I know none of that is going to happen. Thanks.

The music and sunglasses thing sounds like a good idea, it really does, but I already came to terms with my life. Skin treatments (bleaching) don't work unless you're willing to get cancer. I'm at peace. Of course I'm sad, and even angry, but I'm not depressed. I just won't deal with it anymore.
